mutations.label: AB exact membership goes, so a negative-test step that EXPECTS 401 and gets 401 no longer passes: 401 is not 2xx, so the family rule below cannot rescue it. r105 exited rc=1 with no release on business_chain_failing while the app had delivered six times -- business_chain_failing blocks 76 corpus runs, more than any other check.
mutations.find:
if status in expect:
        return True

mutations.label: AD the 2xx family rule drops its 2xx-ACTUAL requirement, so any status passes whenever the expect list contains a 2xx -- a 2xx-expected step returning 4xx scores PASS, which is the genuine failure #553 insists must still fail.
mutations.find:
return (isinstance(status, int) and 200 <= status < 300
            and any(isinstance(e, int) and 200 <= e < 300 for e in expect))
mutations.replace: return any(isinstance(e, int) and 200 <= e < 300 for e in expect)
